result.summary: The street environment features a commercial corridor with sidewalks and street lighting, but lacks basic crossing infrastructure at the intersection. The presence of streetcar tracks and uneven cobblestone surfaces introduces additional physical hazards for pedestrians and those with mobility aids.

hazards.name: Missing Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: Despite the presence of a traffic signal, there are no marked crosswalks to guide pedestrians or alert drivers to crossing locations.

hazards.name: Uneven Pavement Surfaces
hazards.description: The cobblestone roadway and sidewalk transitions are uneven, creating trip hazards and barriers for mobility devices.

hazards.name: Streetcar Tracks
hazards.description: Embedded tracks in the roadway can cause slips for pedestrians and are a significant hazard for cyclists.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at all legs of the intersection to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install compliant curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at the corners to provide accessible transitions.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-specific signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features sidewalks and mature trees but lacks marked crosswalks at the visible intersection. The presence of embedded trolley tracks and uneven cobblestone surfaces introduces significant trip hazards and complicates accessibility.

hazards.name: Embedded Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Metal tracks in the roadway create a trip hazard for pedestrians and a slip hazard for cyclists.

hazards.name: Unmarked Intersection
hazards.description: Lack of marked crosswalks at a multi-leg intersection increases pedestrian exposure and reduces driver awareness.

hazards.name: Uneven Pavement
hazards.description: Cobblestone surfaces on the side street are uneven, posing a risk for those with limited mobility or using assistive devices.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian paths across the intersection.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: ADA Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces to ensure the pedestrian network is accessible to all users.

result.summary: The intersection features pedestrian signals and traffic lights but lacks marked crosswalks and accessible curb ramps. The uneven cobblestone roadway and cluttered sidewalks with trash cans and utility poles present significant mobility and tripping hazards.

hazards.name: Uneven Pavement
hazards.description: The cobblestone street surface is uneven, creating a tripping hazard and making it difficult for those with mobility aids to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway surface in the foreground and intersection area

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The absence of curb ramps at the corner prevents accessible transition from the sidewalk to the street for wheelchair users or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner of the sidewalk near the traffic signal pole

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Trash cans, planters, and utility poles narrow the effective walking width of the sidewalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Sidewalk area adjacent to the building

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install painted or thermoplastic high-visibility crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space to drivers.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped curb ramps at the intersection corners to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Pavement Leveling
interventions.description: Level the cobblestones or provide a smooth paved path within the crosswalk area to reduce tripping hazards.
